name: Realm: red-rock canyonlands (realistic)
description: Setting: a grounded, cinematic red-rock canyonland photographed on location like a feature-film still - layered sandstone, dust and dry scrub, adobe and timber settlements, hard clear sun and long low shadows, warm orange-red earth tones; any magic is a faint glow deep in the stone; nothing from the modern world
notes: The earth homeland as a place: use it with the backgrounds in backgrounds/fantasy/country/earth/ (set components.realm).
